recent.title: Last 200 events
recent.sql: select ts, source, event_type, device_name, summary from events order by ts desc limit 200

per_device_per_day.title: Events per device per day (last 30 days)
per_device_per_day.sql: select date(ts) as day, coalesce(device_name, device_id) as device, count(*) as n from events where ts >= date('now', '-30 days') group by day, device order by day desc, n desc

silent_devices.title: Devices by last event
silent_devices.sql: select d.name, d.type, max(e.ts) as last_event from devices d left join events e on e.device_id = d.device_id group by d.device_id order by last_event

alarm_recent.title: Last 200 alarm panel messages (without zone-timer dumps)
alarm_recent.sql: select received_at, code, data from alarm_messages where code <> '%FF' order by id desc limit 200

health.title: Service heartbeats
health.sql: select service, at, detail from heartbeats
